questions.stem: What is one advantage of a kidney transplant over long-term dialysis?

options.text: A successful transplant allows the patient to live a more normal life without regular treatment sessions
A transplant is available immediately for all patients
A transplant does not require any follow-up medical care
A transplant guarantees the patient will never have kidney problems again

questions.explanation: A successful kidney transplant frees the patient from needing regular dialysis sessions, which can take several hours multiple times per week. This greatly improves quality of life, though the patient must continue taking immunosuppressant drugs.
